purpose: Generate deterministic continuous C08 LiDAR once, run frozen B0/M1D-seeds/GT-oracle semantics through one causal graph builder, and freeze Gate-4 development parameters without C09/C10 or planning.

approval.scope: One 4773-frame Gate-4 C08 causal topology development replay; implementation plus execution; zero C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly replied 批准 after receiving the exact C08 data, five methods, 243-configuration grid, cost, evidence, stop conditions and implementation-plus-execution scope.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of sealed generated assets and project checkpoints; upstream source is not redistributed.

sampling.rule: Read the three sealed independent trajectories; cast 16x720 primary and replay CPU scenes at every exact 2m pose; retain one verified range+valid frame. B0, all three frozen M1D checkpoints and GT oracle consume identical frame IDs. Adjacent frames are not independent samples.

student_input.forbidden: graph/spline/GT/future frames/world ID/absolute xyz as M1D input

teacher.source: Sealed graph/spline objective outgoing directions, branch count and node role; used only for GT oracle and offline metrics.
teacher.valid_mask: Only frames with deterministic dual-scene equality, finite 16x720 output, minimum horizontal clearance >=0.8m and complete objective branch LOS are admitted; any failure stops the whole run rather than replacing frames.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: B0 and all M1D seeds receive no GT; every method uses the same causal builder and trajectory. Verified edges require preserved physical traversal trace.

checkpoints.selection: Already frozen Gate-2 best checkpoints; no checkpoint selection in Gate 4.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only C08 files are opened. C09 is identity-only reserved future validation and is not read; C10/M-TARE/LAMP/SubT/historical NPZ and prototype frames are excluded.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D dual-scene 109,969,920 rays, one RTX 5090 for three frozen checkpoint inference passes, then CPU causal graph sweep; no training.

evidence.machine_metrics: Per-world sensor eligibility/determinism metrics, three-checkpoint inference manifest, complete 3645-row parameter sweep, selected-method metrics and frozen graph parameters.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Three complete C08 trajectory XY/XZ figures colored by objective structural role plus selected graph JSON and frame-level decision traces.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop the affected formal run on any frozen-input drift, ineligible frame, replay mismatch, checkpoint mismatch, oracle integrity failure, untraversed verified edge, forbidden read or evidence loss.

failure_policy: STOP on geometry/source/checkpoint hash drift, raycast or teacher invalidity, replay mismatch, forbidden read, noncausal input, oracle graph integrity failure, untraversed verified edge, evidence loss or need to change the frozen grid/method/metric.
